name: cct
description: Calvin's Claude Tools: the AI-native SDLC as one Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: cct
plugins.description: The SDLC in one self-contained plugin: sdlc-run and every skill, agent and hook it runs, including the UX suite, the product skills, the engineering and data skills run by hand, a project kickoff and the Docker + GitHub Actions blueprint.

plugins.name: agent-tracker
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: a band above every prompt and a /tracker pane that show each session's repo, work and state, and which sessions need you. It acts only on your press: `claude rm` for an ended session and `git worktree remove` for a merged worktree (never forced, branch kept), also in bulk through the skill git-cleanup-run. Early access: Claude Code 2.1.323.

plugins.name: factory-status
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: a status line and a /factory-status pane that show where the factory run in this repo stands (milestone, task, gap loop, needs-you). It only reads. Needs factory 0.8.0.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: A lit software factory for one owner: spec-anchored SDD, layered plans, /goal builds, independent verifiers and platform-gated merges (/factory:run).
